# Pentagram Website Design Analysis

## Navigation Structure
The site employs dual navigation systems: a primary horizontal menu (Work, About, News, Contact, Archive) and a comprehensive filterable search interface organizing projects by industry sectors and discipline types. Social links appear in footer and header areas.

## Page Layout & Project Presentation
Projects utilize a modular card-based system with imagery, categorical tags, and descriptive copy. The Cohere case study demonstrates layered storytelling: opening statement, embedded video players marked "Play," followed by detailed narrative sections with pull quotes and visual hierarchy.

## Typography
The page references custom typefaces including "Cohere Headline" (featuring Voronoi cell cuts), "Cohere Text" (three weights plus italics), and "Cohere Mono" for code environments. System appears to support "306 different languages."

## Color Palette
Natural tones include "coniferous green, mushroom grey and volcanic black" paired with synthetic hues: "simulated coral, synthetic quartz and acrylic blue." Gradient atmospheres provide textural depth without visual dominance.

## Grid & Layout Features
Component-based system using Figma plug-ins enabling "Voronoi patterns" and cell-based layouts. Two "layout component libraries" create adaptive compositions; Cinema 4D tools generate 3D pebble visuals with preset color options.

## Credits & Related Work
Project teams listed with partner designations. "Next Project" navigation links to related work; news section highlights recent client collaborations.

1. **Image galleries within project pages.** Both studios break up their narrative with full-width and multi-column still images. This is the single largest gap. josephibrahim.com's project pages are text-heavy with only a hero video.
